sources.title: Claude plans and pricing — Individual
sources.notes: Official plan cards show Free $0, Pro $20 monthly or $200 annually, and Max from $100. The model comparison has columns Free, Pro, Max 5x, and Max 20x. Its Fable tooltip states: Claude Fable 5 is included on Max plans at 50% of the weekly usage limit; Pro users can access Fable via usage credits. Free does not include Fable or Opus, while Sonnet and Haiku are marked available.

sources.title: What is the Pro plan?
sources.notes: Official documentation confirms $20 monthly pricing, $200 annual billing, a five-hour session reset, a shared all-model weekly limit, and that message capacity varies with message/file/conversation length, model, and feature. It does not publish a fixed token quota.

sources.title: What is the Max plan?
sources.notes: Official documentation confirms Max 5x at $100/month and Max 20x at $200/month, with five and twenty times Pro usage per session respectively, five-hour resets, and an unpublished shared weekly limit.

sources.title: Manage usage credits for paid Claude plans
sources.notes: Official documentation says Pro, Max 5x, and Max 20x users can opt into separately charged Usage Credits; subsequent usage is billed at standard API rates and does not change the five-hour included-limit reset.

sources.title: Claude Fable 5 on your plan
sources.notes: Starting July 20, 2026, Max plans include Fable 5 for up to 50% of the ordinary weekly usage limit at no extra charge; the 50% is not extra quota and Fable consumes the shared limit faster. Pro has no included Fable allowance and uses Usage Credits from the first token.

sources.title: Claude plans and pricing — API
sources.notes: Official Standard input/output and five-minute prompt-cache write/read prices for latest and legacy models. The official Batch toggle displays 50% prices for all four token categories. The page states US-only inference is 1.1x for input and output tokens and Fast mode for Opus 5 is up to 2.5x faster at 2x Standard pricing.

sources.notes: v2.1.227 confirms Max users can be wrongly prompted to enable usage credits for Fable, v2.1.219 says some plans include Fable and publishes Opus 5 Fast mode at $10/$50 per MTok, and v2.1.208 names the Fable 5 usage-credits consent flow.

mergeNotes: The existing provider id anthropic can be updated in place; add anthropic-api as a separate first-party API provider so subscriptions and API token plans remain independently filterable.

Paid-plan included-usage offers carry finite effectiveUsdPerMillionTokens values only as a clearly identified daily-window scenario; estimated=true and comparable=false are mandatory so these values are displayed but never enter cheapest-price rankings.
Paid-plan Usage Credits are a separate exact PAYG plan at standard API rates. They must not be blended with the monthly subscription fee or presented as included quota.
Do not merge Fable 5 into the generic Pro or Max model array without preserving coverageMode and includedWeeklyLimitShare; otherwise the UI will imply the same entitlement as Opus/Sonnet/Haiku.
Only latest-model US-only offers are included because the 1.1x statement is presented with the latest-model section; legacy US-only availability is not asserted.
Effort/reasoning benchmark variants share the canonical model token rate and are explicitly listed in modelSlugs so strict model-detail filtering still finds the offer.
Retired or older Claude families not shown on the current official pricing page are intentionally omitted.
